summary_en: Yamadai (7426) public tender offer at ¥601/share (minimum 402,600 shares, 36.24% S/O) to achieve complete subsidiary status. Founder shareholders (30.43% stake) committed to parallel sale at ¥301/share. Target board recommends. Period: 2 June–13 July 2026 (30 business days).
title_en: Notice of Commencement of Tender Offer for Yamadai Corporation (Securities Code: 7426)
translation_en_brief: Nice Corporation (8089, TSE Standard market) filed notice on 1 June 2026 of a tender offer to acquire all ordinary shares of Yamadai Corporation (7426, TSE Standard market) at ¥601 per share, with the objective of making Yamadai a wholly owned subsidiary. The tender offer runs from 2 June to 13 July 2026 (30 business days) and sets a minimum acceptance threshold of 402,600 shares (36.24% of outstanding shares, excluding treasury stock). Nice currently owns no Yamadai shares. Yamadai's board of directors recommends participation. Concurrently, the founding shareholders—via two entities (Estate Yamadain Ltd., holding 26.75%, and Yamayuki Shokurin Ltd., holding 3.67%), totalling 30.43% of shares—have executed binding agreements to sell all their holdings directly to Nice at ¥301 per share, effective on the settlement date of the tender offer. This parallel acquisition from founders ensures that combined with the tender offer, Nice will acquire substantially all Yamadai shares and achieve the delisting objective.
